newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rig count up 26 to 833 in latest week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rig count up 26 to 833 in latest week.

text.p: The number of rigs exploring for oil and natural gas in the United States stood at 833 as of February 7, up 26 from the prior week and 138 above the year-ago total of 695, Baker Hughes Inc reported.
The number of rigs drilling on land rose by 21 to 701, while rigs working offshore rose four to 111. The number of rigs active in inland waters rose one to 21.
Among the individual states, the biggest changes occurred in Oklahoma, which was up ten, Wyoming, which was up four and North Dakota, which was down two.
